Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Seal Beach is a grid of surface streets where parking is the local currency; the Classic Car Show shuts down Main Street and relies on remote lots and shuttles, which is a direct analogue for party-bus work.
Pacific Coast Highway is the only high-capacity road and becomes a parking lot on summer weekends.
The pier and Main Street are within a short walk, but not for guests in formalwear or heels or with a full bar setup.
SNA is about 11 miles away and Long Beach Airport is about 7 miles, so airport transfers are short and easy.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Seal Beach Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
